title: Charging Ahead: Where EVs Really Stand

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: Welcome to Drive Time, I'm Daniel Osei. Today we're cutting through the noise on electric vehicles with auto industry analyst Karen Liu.

transcript.speaker: Karen
transcript.text: Thanks Daniel. There's a lot of noise to cut through, so let's go.

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: I'll be the skeptic. Electric cars are still only about 5% of global car sales. It's a niche.

transcript.speaker: Karen
transcript.text: That number is badly out of date. Global electric car sales topped 17 million in 2024, which is more than one in five new cars sold.

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: Okay, that genuinely surprises me. Where is adoption the most extreme?

transcript.speaker: Karen
transcript.text: Norway, no contest. Almost 89% of new cars sold there in 2024 were fully electric.

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: The thing that scares buyers is the battery. An EV battery typically needs replacing after about three years, and that's a huge bill.

transcript.speaker: Karen
transcript.text: I hear that a lot, and I think it's mostly fear left over from the early days. My own car is past 60,000 miles and the range has barely moved.

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: What about charging? That's what my listeners complain about.

transcript.speaker: Karen
transcript.text: Public charging is the real problem. It's patchy, half the apps are awful, and that's what keeps people in gas cars.

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: For the brands listening, what should EV marketing focus on?

transcript.speaker: Karen
transcript.text: Total cost of ownership and the driving experience. Stop selling guilt and start selling fun.

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: Give me a prediction to hold you to.

transcript.speaker: Karen
transcript.text: Half of all new cars sold in the US will be electric by 2030.

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: We'll check back in 2030. Karen Liu, thanks for joining Drive Time.
